title.zh: 被持有的生命上的生生之意义

statement.zh: 每个活的主张都被某个立场持有时，生生之意义恰等于每个立场的自身意义加立场中立，不需要连通与关系中立；在连通、每个立场都持有活主张的整体上，自身意义加关系中立是另一种补全。
statement.en: Where every living claim is held, living significance is exactly self-significance everywhere with standpoint neutrality, without connection or relational neutrality; on a connected whole where each standpoint holds a living claim, self-significance with relational neutrality suffices too.

laws.zh: 在估值上，一个活的主张在某个立场的自身区域中，称为被持有；Held 是每个活的主张都被持有，Unheld 是一个主张无人持有。
laws.en: On a valuation, a living claim is held when it lies in the own region of some standpoint; Held is every living claim being held, and Unheld is a claim no standpoint holds.

laws.zh: 每个活的主张都被持有时，生生之意义（主张层面：每个活的主张从每个立场都有意义）恰等于每个立场的自身意义加立场中立，既不用连通，也不用关系中立。
laws.en: Where every living claim is held, living significance at the level of claims (every living claim significant from every standpoint) is exactly self-significance at every standpoint with standpoint neutrality, using neither connection nor relational neutrality.

laws.zh: 持有可判定、每个活的主张都经已形成的关系从一个被持有的活的主张到达时，生生之意义恰等于每个立场的自身意义、立场中立与只指向无人持有者的关系中立。
laws.en: With holding decided and every living claim reached through formed relations from a held living claim, living significance is exactly self-significance at every standpoint, standpoint neutrality, and relational neutrality into claims no standpoint holds.

laws.zh: 持有与自身意义不够：每个生命都被持有、只被自己的立场珍视时自身意义处处成立，而立场中立、关系中立与生生之意义都不成立。
laws.en: Holding and self-significance do not suffice: with every life held and valued by its own standpoint only, self-significance holds everywhere while standpoint neutrality, relational neutrality and living significance fail.

laws.zh: 持有与指向无人持有者的关系中立都必要：一个无人持有的生命在自身意义与立场中立之下没有意义；从被持有者到达而无人持有的生命，在自身意义与立场中立之下没有意义，指向无人持有者的关系中立不成立。
laws.en: Holding and relational neutrality into unheld claims are needed: a life no standpoint holds has no significance under self-significance and standpoint neutrality; a life reached from a held one that no standpoint holds has no significance under self-significance and standpoint neutrality, relational neutrality into unheld claims failing.

laws.zh: 自身意义本身已使每个立场的意义沿任何关系进入其自身区域。
laws.en: Self-significance already carries each standpoint's significance along any relation into its own region.

laws.zh: 立场中立不是唯一的补全：在连通、每个立场都持有某个活主张的整体上，处处自身意义加关系中立不用立场中立也给出生生之意义。
laws.en: Standpoint neutrality is not the only completion: on a connected whole where every standpoint holds a living claim, self-significance at every standpoint with relational neutrality gives living significance without standpoint neutrality.

laws.zh: 逐步读、每个形成以自身的事件为自身区域时，每个活的事件都被持有，所以生生之意义恰等于每个形成的自身意义加立场中立。
laws.en: Read stepwise with each formation a standpoint whose own region is its own events, every living event is held, so living significance is exactly self-significance at every formation with standpoint neutrality.

With the formations as standpoints, each one's own region its closure under any relation of the unfolding and living and related the stepwise reading, sig is the only evaluative parameter supplied. The own region is the least boundary; every event is held, so living significance is self-significance with standpoint neutrality; the empty relation gives the case above, feeding the feeding closure.
laws.zh: 以形成为立场，各自的自身区域取它在展开的任一关系下的闭包，living 与 related 取逐步读法，则 sig 是唯一给出的评价参数。自身区域是最小边界；每个事件都被持有，所以生命意义是自身意义加立场中立；空关系给出上面的情形，供给给出供给闭包。

hypotheses.zh: 持有：每个活的主张在某个立场的自身区域中；这是对应的前提。把 Ren 提议中的“想要自身延续者”读作持有、把 S0 读作想要，是 AI 提出的读法，依 Ren 的交托采用。
hypotheses.en: Holding: every living claim lies in some standpoint's own region, a correspondence premise. Reading ‘anything that wants its continuation’ as holding and S0 as wanting is the AI's proposed reading, adopted on Ren's delegation.

hypotheses.zh: significant_iff_reached 需要持有可判定，是表示的逻辑承诺，同可判定相等。
hypotheses.en: significant_iff_reached needs holding to be decided, a logical commitment of the representation, as decided equality is.

hypotheses.zh: significant_of_transmits 需要连通，并需要每个立场都持有某个活的主张。
hypotheses.en: significant_of_transmits needs connection and every standpoint holding some living claim.

hypotheses.zh: S0、N_std 与 N_rel 都是假设，不是证明了的前提；本结果说 G0 在被持有的生命上恰等于哪些前提，不证明它们。
hypotheses.en: S0, N_std and N_rel are hypotheses, not proved premises; the result says exactly which premises G0 amounts to on held lives and proves none of them.

hypotheses.zh: G0 已由 Ren 2026-10-11 折叠，不再是公理：在被持有的生命上，这一刻画是第一部分把 G0 作为条件陈述的一种；重述的读法依 Ren 的交托决定。
hypotheses.en: G0 was folded by Ren on 11 October 2026 and is no longer an axiom: on held lives, this characterization is one of the ways Part I states G0 as a condition; the readings of the restatement are decided on Ren's delegation.

Standpoints as formations: the laws on valuations hold for any type of standpoints, and this is the instance Pos := F; which relation a center's region is drawn along is supplied, read off the unfolding, not derived.
hypotheses.zh: 以形成为立场：评价之律对任何类型的立场成立，这是实例 Pos := F；中心的区域沿哪个关系划出是给出的，从展开读出，不是推出的。

does_not_show.zh: 不证明自身意义、立场中立或关系中立，不约束拒绝它们的立场，不推出义务、排序、认识或遵循。
does_not_show.en: Proves none of self-significance, standpoint neutrality or relational neutrality, binds no rejecting standpoint, and infers no duty, ranking, recognition or compliance.

does_not_show.zh: 哪些形成想要，不由本结果给出（一种读法：“想要”读作自身意义）。
does_not_show.en: Which formations want is not given here (a reading: wanting is read as self-significance).

does_not_show.zh: 自身意义只涉及活的主张，逐步读时它已含“不损”的过滤（Clearing.clearer_not_living），这是规范性的读法。
does_not_show.en: Self-significance ranges over living claims, so on the stepwise reading it carries the not-harm filter (Clearing.clearer_not_living), a normative reading.

does_not_show.zh: 主张层面的意义分不开把他者算作条件与算作想要者。
does_not_show.en: Claim-level significance does not separate counting another as a condition from counting it as a being that wants.

does_not_show.zh: 无人持有的生命（休眠的种子、昏迷、不再想继续的人）不在本结果的定理之内；它们在延续条件的范围内，这一意义不决定任何人应当做什么。
does_not_show.en: Lives no standpoint holds (a dormant seed, a coma, someone who no longer wants to go on) are outside this result's theorems; they are within the range of the continuation condition, a significance that decides nothing about what anyone should do.

does_not_show.zh: 只陈述主张层面的生生之意义。
does_not_show.en: Living significance is stated at the level of claims only.

detail.zh: 每个前提都必要：Apart（每个生命都被持有、只被自己的立场珍视，两种中立都不成立：持有与自身意义不够）、Unclaimed（无人持有的生命）、Relayed（被到达而无人持有的生命）。
detail.en: Each premise is needed: Apart (every life held and valued by its own standpoint only, neither neutrality holding: holding and self-significance do not suffice), Unclaimed (a life no standpoint holds), Relayed (a reached life no standpoint holds).

detail.zh: 立场中立不是唯一的补全：在连通、每个立场都持有活主张的整体上，自身意义加关系中立给出生生之意义（Valuation.significant_of_transmits）。
detail.en: Standpoint neutrality is not the only completion: on a connected whole where every standpoint holds a living claim, self-significance with relational neutrality gives living significance (Valuation.significant_of_transmits).

next_delta.zh: 区分工具性与最终意义的表示；立场中立的哲学根据；整段读法与关系层上的同一形式；与 universal_reason 的接通。
next_delta.en: A representation separating instrumental from final significance; the philosophical ground of standpoint neutrality; the same form on the whole-run reading and at the level of relations; connecting to universal_reason.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的提议说：“it can be anything that want's its continuation to have significance”，又说：“if we want to add one axiom, that is for anything, its continuation into the future has significance”。AI 把它分为两半，Ren 答“exactly”：动力学定出想要延续者必须计入的范围，定不出中心；那条公理的唯一作用是让每一点都是中心。本结果给出中心一半的形式内容。形式上，“每个想要之点都是中心”落在 S0 上，S0 是每个想要之点上的种子；在被持有的生命上，G0 超出 S0 的可以集中在 N_std 上：从任一中心有意义的，从每个立场都有意义，没有哪个中心特殊。把 S0 读作想要、把 N_std 读作那条公理，是 AI 对提议的读法，依 Ren 的交托采用（DELEGATED-CHOICES D11）。N_std 不是唯一的补全：在连通、每个立场都持有活主张的整体上，N_rel 也补全 S0；把关系读作依存时，N_rel 正是“计入自身延续所依存的”的评价形式，所以在依存使每两个生命都相连的整体中，推出的范围加 S0 就到达每个生命。选 N_std 是因为它不需要连通，不是因为它是唯一的补全。与 metaethical-core-characterization 的关系：那里从一个种子出发，需要连通与 N_rel；这里在每个想要的点都有种子，在被持有的生命上只需要 N_std。在连通、有活的主张且每个生命都被持有的整体上，二者都等价于 G0；一般地互不蕴涵，原刻画保持其范围。self-good-reachable-g0 留下了从立场相对的意义到规范意义的桥；AI 的读法把这座桥命名为唯一公理。对手的形状不变：主要的对手接受处处 S0，把意义限在各自的立场之内（Apart，两种中立都不成立），这正是那条公理所否认的边界。
correspondence.en: Ren's proposal says “it can be anything that want's its continuation to have significance” and “if we want to add one axiom, that is for anything, its continuation into the future has significance”. The AI analysis, which Ren answered “exactly”, splits it in two halves: the dynamics fixes the extent of what a wanting formation must count, not its center; the axiom's one job is to put a center at every point. This result gives the formal content of the center. Formally, a center at every wanting point is S0, the seed at each; on held lives, what G0 adds beyond S0 can be concentrated in N_std: what has significance from any center has it from every standpoint, and no center is privileged. Reading S0 as wanting and N_std as the axiom is the AI's reading of the proposal, adopted on Ren's delegation (DELEGATED-CHOICES D11). N_std is not the only completion: on a connected whole where every standpoint holds a living claim, N_rel also completes S0; with the relations read as dependence, N_rel is the valuation form of counting what one's continuation depends on, so in a whole where dependence links every two lives the derived extent with S0 reaches every life. N_std is chosen because it needs no connection, not because it is the only completion. Relation to metaethical-core-characterization: that route starts from one seed and needs connection and N_rel; this one seeds every wanting point and, on held lives, needs only N_std. Where the whole is connected, some claim is living and every life is held, both are equivalent to G0; in general neither implies the other, and the earlier characterization keeps its scope. self-good-reachable-g0 left a bridge from standpoint-relative to normative significance; the AI's reading names that bridge as the one axiom. The shape of rivals persists: the principal rival accepts S0 everywhere and keeps significance within each standpoint (Apart, where neither neutrality holds), the boundary the axiom denies.

detail.en: Reuses Valuation, SelfSignificance, transmits, shares, Neutral, Within, Significant, Connected, Reach, reaches and Invariant.reach; the earlier characterization significant_iff keeps its scope.

output.en: The valuation, S0, the two neutralities, connection and G0; invariants along relations.

input.zh: 被持有的生命上 G0 恰等于处处 S0 加 N_std；连通时 S0 加 N_rel 也给出 G0。
input.en: On held lives G0 is exactly S0 everywhere with N_std; on a connected whole S0 with N_rel also gives G0.

conditions.zh: 持有；significant_iff_reached 另需持有可判定与到达；significant_of_transmits 需要连通与每个立场持有活的主张。
conditions.en: Holding; significant_iff_reached also needs decided holding and reach; significant_of_transmits needs connection and every standpoint holding a living claim.

detail.zh: 复用逐步读法的估值 Web.valuation（living：活跃且不侵蚀；related：共同参与）。
detail.en: Reuses the stepwise valuation Web.valuation (living: active and not undermining; related: co-participation).

output.en: The stepwise valuation of a web.

input.zh: 每个形成以自身事件为自身区域时，每个活的事件都被持有。
input.en: With each formation's own events its own region, every living event is held.

detail.zh: 那里留下了从立场相对的意义到规范意义的桥；这里说明在被持有的生命上，G0 超出 S0 的可以集中在 N_std 上。
detail.en: It left a bridge from standpoint-relative to normative significance; here, on held lives, what G0 adds beyond S0 can be concentrated in N_std.

detail.zh: 在逐步读法上陈述中心沿依存不由动力学推出（Clearing.center_not_derived），复用本结果的 Web.held_by_formations。
detail.en: States on the stepwise reading that along dependence the center is not derived (Clearing.center_not_derived), reusing this result's Web.held_by_formations.

detail.zh: 连通与 N_rel 的读法给出另一种补全，并对无人持有的生命仍有作用。
detail.en: Readings of connection and N_rel give the other completion and keep a role for lives no standpoint holds.

history.en: 14 October 2026, migrated to schema 2 (item F of the open-issues plan: the migration of the 45 schema-1 records with the most lint findings; Ren: “please, do all”, relayed by the integrating session): the claim became 8 laws; the limitations went to does-not-show items, standard boundaries and the hypotheses; the evidence became one paragraph. The three witnesses of “each is needed” became two laws (Apart; Unclaimed and Relayed), each opening with what it shows. “That the extent derived along dependence does not fix the center is shown in derived-extent-limits” is carried by the existing related link. “No ethical axiom and no Lean axiom is used: S0, N_std and N_rel are hypotheses of the theorems” joined the evidence and the hypotheses (hypotheses[3]); the standard boundary no-ethical-premise is not cited, since S0, N_std and N_rel are normative premises. The fold of G0 (a sentence of the limitations and the last sentence of the correspondence, P51) became one hypothesis, without P51; the list of names (Held, Unheld, Apart, Unclaimed, Relayed and others) is carried by the standard boundary names-provisional and the last text_versions entry. The theorem, module and audit counts, the core-purity detail, the review file name with §47.1–47.4 and the periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z of the evidence stay in the receipts, the references and the last text_versions entry. No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [held-lives-g0-is-centering.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/held-lives-g0-is-centering.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.

history.zh: 2026-10-16 P110（依 Ren 2026-10-15 的交托决定的读法，研究 §147，DELEGATED-CHOICES D11, D14）：此前留给 Ren 的读法与名称按所列决定改为采用或不采用，要求 Ren 判断这些读法的下一步已删去。陈述、证明与绑定不变；Ren 可改其中任何一项决定。
history.en: 16 October 2026, P110 (readings decided on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, study section 147, DELEGATED-CHOICES D11, D14): readings and names formerly left to Ren are adopted or declined as those decisions say, and next steps asking for Ren's judgment on them are removed. Statements, proofs and bindings unchanged; Ren can reverse any of the decisions.

17 October 2026, wording of the public fields: outdated labels (G0, S0, N_rel/N_std, the axiom) replaced by the current vocabulary (living significance, self-significance, relational and standpoint neutrality, the continuation condition); delegation phrasing (“on Ren's delegation”) replaced by marking the readings as readings; the attribution “by Ren's words” removed, following Ren's 17 October directive that his earlier words are provenance, not authority; the claim is unchanged.

18 October 2026, the N1 renaming (Ren: "Renames, full scope"): BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md changed by the renaming (identifiers renamed; the chapter's glossary gains a table of retired Lean names; the renewal study gains section 172). Read the change: it touches no statement of this record; re-pointed, the claim is unchanged.

20 October 2026, R30 (one notion, one name: names that stated a meaning the statement does not have, or collided, renamed by one table, development/r30-names/RENAME-TABLE.json): Renamed: SelfGood (now SelfSignificance); Valuation.SelfGood (now Valuation.SelfSignificance). Proof bindings (Metaethics.lean, Standpoints.lean, ValuationFrames.lean) rebound to core receipt 20261019T194851.524223Z. Re-pointed after reading the change: Metaethics.lean, G0 is LivingSignificance, g0_* livingSignificance_*, Valuation.SelfGood Valuation.SelfSignificance, SecuresPositiveGround SecuresNewContent, the binder positive relevance; the module header is structural; statements unchanged; Standpoints.lean, declarations, namespaces and uses renamed by the R30 table (one notion, one name); statements and proofs unchanged; ValuationFrames.lean, declarations, namespaces and uses renamed by the R30 table (one notion, one name); statements and proofs unchanged. Also re-pointed after reading the change: BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md, section 221 added; the links of earlier sections to the renamed modules' files follow the table, their text unchanged. The claim is unchanged.

history.en: 20 October 2026, R34 (one evaluative chain: the run classes and widening, one object of admission, standpoints as formations, the direction on a web's moves, worlds read as webs): A law added (D3 and F7 of the twentieth review): standpoints as formations with each one's own region its closure under a relation of the unfolding (Web.selfValuation and its laws, Boundaries.lean), so that sig is the only supplied evaluative parameter; with a premise naming the instance. The earlier laws are unchanged. Also: Proof bindings (Metaethics.lean, Standpoints.lean, ValuationFrames.lean) rebound to core receipt 20261020T005554.047169Z. Re-pointed after reading the change: BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md, section 225 added; Metaethics.lean, docstrings only (standpoints of any type, obs the second supplied relation, the fixed-type limit, the run classes) or an import; kept statements unchanged; Standpoints.lean, docstrings only (standpoints of any type, obs the second supplied relation, the fixed-type limit, the run classes) or an import; kept statements unchanged; ValuationFrames.lean, LivingSignificance moved to Extension, unchanged; kept statements unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年10月20日，R34（一条评价之链：整段的类与扩大，接纳这一个对象，以形成为立场，网之动作上的方向，世界读作网）：新增一条规律（第二十次审查 D3 与 F7）：以形成为立场，各自的自身区域取它在展开的某个关系下的闭包（Web.selfValuation 及其规律，Boundaries.lean），使 sig 是唯一给出的评价参数；另加一条写明该实例的前提。原有规律不变。另：证明绑定（Metaethics.lean、Standpoints.lean、ValuationFrames.lean）改到核心回执 20261020T005554.047169Z。读过改动后重新指向：BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md，新增第 225 节；Metaethics.lean，只改说明（任何类型的立场、obs 是第二个给出的关系、固定类型的界、整段的类）或导入；保留的陈述不变；Standpoints.lean，只改说明（任何类型的立场、obs 是第二个给出的关系、固定类型的界、整段的类）或导入；保留的陈述不变；ValuationFrames.lean，LivingSignificance 原样移到 Extension；保留的陈述不变。
